mapper.select: SELECT MAX(CAST(SUBSTRING(syh, -4) AS UNSIGNED)) FROM bgxt_brxx WHERE syh IS NOT NULL AND LENGTH(syh) = 12 AND syh LIKE #{prefix} AND CAST(syh AS UNSIGNED) > 0 AND DATE(jyrq) = DATE(#{date})
SELECT ybzt FROM bgxt_brxx WHERE brxx_id = #{brxxId}
SELECT IFNULL(dycs, 0) FROM bgxt_brxx WHERE brxx_id = #{brxxId}
SELECT COUNT(1) FROM bgxt_brxx WHERE DATE(jyrq) = DATE(#{date})
SELECT brxx_id FROM bgxt_brxx WHERE brxx_tmh = #{tmh} LIMIT 1
SELECT sb_djid, bbzl, brxb, nllx, brnl FROM bgxt_brxx WHERE brxx_id = #{brxxId} LIMIT 1

SELECT b.brxx_id, b.syh, b.brxm, b.brxb, b.brnl, b.nllx, b.brlb, b.brch, b.brxx_tmh, b.brbh, b.jyrq, b.shrq, b.lczd, b.sjys, b.jyys, b.shys, b.bbzl AS bbzlCode, b.sb_djid, b.bgbh, b.bgmc, b.bgbt, b.bgyj, k.ksmc AS ksdm, bb.bmsm AS bbzl, (SELECT yymc FROM sys_config LIMIT 1) AS yymc FROM bgxt_brxx b LEFT JOIN sys_kssz k ON b.ksdm = k.ksdm LEFT JOIN sys_bbzl bb ON b.bbzl = bb.bm WHERE b.brxx_id=#{brxxId} LIMIT 1
SELECT brxx_id, brxx_tmh, brbh, brxm, brxb, brnl, nllx, brlb, syqk, ksdm, brch, syh, bbzl, ybzt, jyrq, shrq, sfbz, bz, czy, czrq FROM bgxt_brxx WHERE brxx_id = #{brxxId}
SELECT bmsm FROM sys_bbzl WHERE bm = #{bm} LIMIT 1
mapper.update: UPDATE bgxt_brxx SET ybzt = #{ybzt} WHERE brxx_id = #{brxxId}
UPDATE bgxt_brxx SET ybzt = 1, jyys = #{jyys} WHERE brxx_id = #{brxxId}
UPDATE bgxt_brxx SET ybzt = 2, shrq = NOW(), shys = #{shys} WHERE brxx_id = #{brxxId} AND ybzt IN (1, 4)
UPDATE bgxt_brxx SET ybzt = 1, shrq = NULL, shys = NULL WHERE brxx_id = #{brxxId}
UPDATE bgxt_brxx SET ybzt = 3, dybz = 1, dycs = #{printCount}, bgrq = NOW() WHERE brxx_id = #{brxxId}
UPDATE bgxt_brxx SET sfbz = 1, bz = #{reason} WHERE brxx_id = #{brxxId}
UPDATE bgxt_brxx SET sfbz = 0, bz = #{remarks} WHERE brxx_id = #{brxxId}
UPDATE bgxt_brxx SET bz = #{remarks} WHERE brxx_id = #{brxxId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO bgxt_brxx (brxx_id, brxx_tmh, brbh, brxm, brxb, brnl, nllx, brlb, syh, syqk, ksdm, brch, bbzl, lczd, jyys, shys, jyrq, ybzt, sb_djid) VALUES (#{brxxId}, #{brxxTmh}, #{brbh}, #{brxm}, #{brxb}, #{brnl}, #{nllx}, #{brlb}, #{syh}, #{syqk}, #{ksdm}, #{brch}, #{bbzl}, #{lczd}, #{jyys}, #{shys}, NOW(), 0, #{sbDjid})
mapper.select:
SELECT DISTINCT b.brxx_id FROM bgxt_brxx b WHERE 1=1 AND DATE(b.jyrq) = DATE(#{date})
AND b.syh LIKE CONCAT('%',#{sampleNo},'%')
AND b.brxm LIKE CONCAT('%',#{name},'%')
AND b.brxx_tmh LIKE CONCAT('%',#{barcode},'%')

SELECT brxx_id AS id, brxx_tmh AS barcode, brbh AS patientId, brxm AS name, CASE brxb WHEN 1 THEN '男' WHEN 2 THEN '女' ELSE '' END AS sex, brnl AS age, ksdm AS ward, brch AS bedNo, syh AS sampleNo, ybzt AS status FROM bgxt_brxx WHERE 1=1
AND DATE(jyrq) = DATE(#{date})
AND jyrq >= DATE_SUB(NOW(), INTERVAL 7 DAY)
AND syh LIKE CONCAT('%',#{sampleNo},'%')
AND brxm LIKE CONCAT('%',#{name},'%')
AND brxx_tmh LIKE CONCAT('%',#{barcode},'%')
AND brbh LIKE CONCAT('%',#{patientId},'%')
ORDER BY jyrq DESC, syh DESC

SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN ybzt = 0 OR ybzt IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS statusEntry, SUM(CASE WHEN ybzt = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS statusInspected, SUM(CASE WHEN ybzt = 2 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS statusAudited, SUM(CASE WHEN ybzt = 3 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS statusPrinted, SUM(CASE WHEN sfbz = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS statusInvalid, COUNT(*) AS total FROM bgxt_brxx WHERE DATE(jyrq) = DATE(#{date})

SELECT brxx_id AS id, syh AS sampleNo, brxm AS name, brxb AS sex, brnl AS age, nllx AS ageUnit, bbzl AS sampleType, ybzt AS status, sfbz AS isInvalid, bz AS remarks, jyrq AS testDate FROM bgxt_brxx WHERE DATE(jyrq) = DATE(#{date}) AND (sfbz = 1 OR LENGTH(IFNULL(bz, '')) > 0) ORDER BY jyrq DESC
SELECT brxx_id FROM bgxt_brxx WHERE syh = #{syh} AND sb_djid = #{sbDjid} AND ybzt IN (0, 1, 4) LIMIT 1
mapper.update: UPDATE bgxt_brxx SET yczt = #{yczt} WHERE brxx_id = #{brxxId}
UPDATE bgxt_brxx SET yczt = 99, bz = CONCAT(COALESCE(bz,''), ' [报告不正确:', #{reason}, ']') WHERE brxx_id = #{brxxId}
mapper.select:
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM bgxt_brxx b WHERE 1=1
AND DATE(b.jyrq) >= DATE(#{startDate})
AND DATE(b.jyrq) <= DATE(#{endDate})
AND CASE #{patientType} WHEN '门诊病人' THEN b.brlb=1 WHEN '住院病人' THEN b.brlb=2 WHEN '体检人员' THEN b.brlb=3 WHEN '其他病人' THEN b.brlb=4 WHEN '科研人员' THEN b.brlb=5 END
AND b.ksdm = #{department}

SELECT CASE COALESCE(brlb,0) WHEN 1 THEN '门诊' WHEN 2 THEN '住院' WHEN 3 THEN '体检' WHEN 4 THEN '其他' WHEN 5 THEN '科研' WHEN 0 THEN '未知' ELSE CONCAT('其他(', COALESCE(brlb,0), ')') END AS name, COALESCE(brlb,0) AS brlb, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM bgxt_brxx GROUP BY brlb ORDER BY cnt DESC

SELECT CASE ybzt WHEN 0 THEN '登记' WHEN 1 THEN '未审核' WHEN 2 THEN '已审核' WHEN 3 THEN '已打印' WHEN 4 THEN '已检验' WHEN 5 THEN '初审' WHEN 6 THEN '复审' WHEN -1 THEN '已作废' ELSE CONCAT('未知(', ybzt, ')') END AS statusName, ybzt, COUNT(*) as cnt FROM bgxt_brxx GROUP BY ybzt ORDER BY ybzt
SELECT DATE(jyrq) as stat_date, COUNT(*) as cnt FROM bgxt_brxx WHERE jyrq >= DATE_SUB(CURDATE(), INTERVAL 7 DAY) GROUP BY DATE(jyrq) ORDER BY stat_date
SELECT DISTINCT jyys AS doctorCode, jyys AS doctorName FROM bgxt_brxx WHERE jyys IS NOT NULL AND jyys != '' ORDER BY jyys
SELECT DISTINCT shys AS doctorCode, shys AS doctorName FROM bgxt_brxx WHERE shys IS NOT NULL AND shys != '' ORDER BY shys
SELECT brxx_id, syh AS syh_group, syh FROM bgxt_brxx ORDER BY brxx_id DESC
SELECT b.brxx_tmh, b.brxm, b.brxb, b.brnl, b.ksdm, k.ksmc, b.brch, b.syh, b.bbzl, b.syqk, b.jyrq FROM bgxt_brxx b LEFT JOIN sys_kssz k ON b.ksdm = k.ksdm WHERE b.brxx_id = #{brxxId} LIMIT 1
SELECT IFNULL(MAX(CAST(SUBSTRING(brxx_tmh, LENGTH(#{prefix}) + 1) AS UNSIGNED)), 0) FROM bgxt_brxx WHERE brxx_tmh LIKE CONCAT(#{prefix}, '%')
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM bgxt_brxx WHERE brxm = #{brxm} AND brxx_id NOT IN (SELECT MAX(brxx_id) FROM bgxt_brxx WHERE brxm = #{brxm})
DELETE FROM bgxt_brxx WHERE brxm LIKE '%' || CHAR(0xEF) || '%' OR brxm LIKE '%' || CHAR(0xBF) || '%' OR brxm = '' OR brxm IS NULL

DELETE FROM bgxt_brxx WHERE brxm = #{brxm} AND brxb = #{brxb} AND brnl = #{brnl} AND brlb = #{brlb} AND jyrq = #{jyrq} AND brxx_id NOT IN (SELECT MAX(brxx_id) FROM bgxt_brxx WHERE brxm = #{brxm} AND brxb = #{brxb} AND brnl = #{brnl} AND brlb = #{brlb} AND jyrq = #{jyrq})
mapper.update: UPDATE bgxt_brxx SET ybzt = 2, shys = #{shys}, shrq = NOW() WHERE brxx_id = #{brxxId}
UPDATE bgxt_brxx SET ybzt = 3, dybz = 1, dycs = COALESCE(dycs, 0) + 1, bgrq = NOW() WHERE brxx_id = #{brxxId}
UPDATE bgxt_brxx SET ybzt = 4, jyys = #{jyys} WHERE brxx_id = #{brxxId}
UPDATE bgxt_brxx SET ybzt = 5 WHERE brxx_id = #{brxxId}
UPDATE bgxt_brxx SET ybzt = 6 WHERE brxx_id = #{brxxId}
UPDATE bgxt_brxx SET ybzt = 1, shys = NULL, shrq = NULL WHERE brxx_id = #{brxxId}
UPDATE bgxt_brxx SET ybzt = 1, jyys = NULL WHERE brxx_id = #{brxxId}
UPDATE bgxt_brxx SET ybzt = 1 WHERE brxx_id = #{brxxId}
UPDATE bgxt_brxx SET ybzt = 5 WHERE brxx_id = #{brxxId}
UPDATE bgxt_brxx SET sfbz = #{sfbz} WHERE brxx_id = #{brxxId}
mapper.select:
SELECT b.brxx_id AS id, b.brxx_tmh AS barcode, b.brbh AS patientId, b.brxm AS name, CASE b.brxb WHEN 1 THEN '男' WHEN 2 THEN '女' ELSE '' END AS sex, b.brnl AS age, b.ksdm AS ward, b.brch AS bedNo, b.syh AS sampleNo, b.ybzt AS status, b.sfbz AS billingStatus, b.jyrq AS inspectionDate FROM bgxt_brxx b WHERE 1=1
AND b.syh LIKE CONCAT('%',#{syh},'%')
AND b.brxm LIKE CONCAT('%',#{brxm},'%')
AND b.brxx_tmh LIKE CONCAT('%',#{brxxTmh},'%')
AND DATE(b.jyrq) = DATE(#{jyrq})
ORDER BY b.jyrq DESC, b.syh DESC LIMIT 500
mapper.update: UPDATE bgxt_brxx SET jyrq = COALESCE(#{jyrq}, jyrq), shrq = COALESCE(#{shrq}, shrq) WHERE brxx_id = #{brxxId}
mapper.select: SELECT m.id, m.cjid, m.xmid, m.jyjg AS rawResult, m.mgd, m.od, z.cjrq, z.syh, z.sb_djid, z.hb_sb_djid FROM sys_cjysz_mx m JOIN sys_cjysz_zb z ON m.cjid = z.cjid WHERE z.syh = (SELECT syh FROM bgxt_brxx WHERE brxx_id = #{brxxId}) AND z.sb_djid = (SELECT sb_djid FROM bgxt_brxx WHERE brxx_id = #{brxxId}) ORDER BY m.id DESC
mapper.update: UPDATE bgxt_brxx SET jyrq = #{targetDate}, sb_djid = #{targetInstrument}, syh = #{targetSyh}, bz = CONCAT(COALESCE(bz, ''), ' [样本转移:', #{startNo}, '->', #{targetSyh}, ']') WHERE brxx_id = #{brxxId}
mapper.select: SELECT brxx_id, brxx_tmh, brxm, brxb, brnl, brlb, syh, ybzt, sb_djid FROM bgxt_brxx WHERE brxx_tmh = #{barcode} LIMIT 1
mapper.update: UPDATE bgxt_brxx SET ybzt = 1, jyrq = NOW() WHERE brxx_tmh = #{barcode} AND ybzt IN (0, 5, 6)
mapper.select: SELECT b.brxx_id, b.brxx_tmh, b.brbh, b.brxm, b.brxb, b.brnl, b.nllx, b.brlb, b.syqk, b.ksdm, b.brch, b.syh, b.bbzl, b.ybzt, b.jyrq, b.shrq, b.lczd, b.jyys, b.shys, b.sb_djid, b.bgbh, b.bgmc, k.ksmc FROM bgxt_brxx b LEFT JOIN sys_kssz k ON b.ksdm = k.ksdm WHERE b.brxx_id = #{brxxId}

SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN ybzt = 0 OR ybzt = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS pending, SUM(CASE WHEN ybzt = 2 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS audited, SUM(CASE WHEN ybzt = 3 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS printed FROM bgxt_brxx WHERE DATE(jyrq) = DATE(#{date})
